title: Business Central 29.0 Is Generally Available: What Cloud Customers and Partners Need to Do.
summary: Business Central version 29.0 (2026 release wave 2) is now generally available, marking the start of the next upgrade cycle for cloud customers. New customers will be provisioned with version 29.0, and existing Business Central 28 customers should prepare for upgrades through testing, notification configuration, extension validation, and scheduled maintenance planning.
key_points: New Business Central cloud environments now start with version 29.0; version 28 will eventually be removed from creation options
Administrators must configure notification recipients to receive Microsoft upgrade and compatibility alerts
Production upgrades should be scheduled after sandbox testing completes, with update windows aligned to customer time zones and maintenance periods
Per-Tenant Extensions must be validated against version 29.0 before production upgrades
Customers planning version 28 go-live should create required environments immediately while that version remains available

quotes.text: New Business Central cloud environments will start with Business Central 29.0.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that all new customer provisioning immediately shifts to the latest version upon GA
